name: Northern Lights — Incident Pack Form (draft, not deployed)

parameters.formDescription: Plate, notes and photos only. Nothing here is sent anywhere automatically — submitting only writes local files for the incident-pack CLI to assemble into a PDF.

meta.note: Draft export, not imported/activated in any n8n instance. Adjust NORTHERN_LIGHTS_WORKDIR and NORTHERN_LIGHTS_TOOL_DIR env vars to your environment before importing. This workflow makes no external API calls — it only writes local files and shells out to the local incident_pack.py CLI. The resulting PDF sits on disk for a human to pick up; nothing is emailed, posted, or sent to any third party.
